**Volume:** T15

**Dynasty:** 劉宋
**Date:** 420–479

- 先公 (A000324)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T640 (one fascicle, alt. title 逮慧三昧經) is a single-fascicle excerpt of the *Samādhirāja-sūtra*, attributed to the Liú-Sòng translator known only as "Xiāngōng" 先公. It corresponds approximately to fascicle 6 of [T639](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0276) (Narendrayaśas's complete translation) and represents an independent earlier rendering of a portion of the same Indic source.

**Abstract**

The translator [先公](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%88%E5%85%AC) is a shadowy figure: the *[Chū sānzàng jì jí](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0084)* (T2145) records the title 先公 — literally "the Former Gentleman" or "Elder Sir" — as the only attribution available, and modern scholarship has not been able to identify him with any other named monk. He is consistently classed in the catalogs as a Liú-Sòng era (420–479) translator. Some later catalogs attempt to identify him with Xiāngōngzhú 先公竺, but this is speculative. T640 and the closely related [T641](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0278) are his only attested works. Date bracket follows the Liú-Sòng span (420–479).

The text is a partial translation of the *Samādhirājasūtra*; comparison with [T639](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0276) shows that T640 corresponds to the central chapter of the *sūtra* on the *yuèdēng* (Moon-Lamp) samādhi proper, and would have served as a manageable single-fascicle introduction to the larger doctrinal complex.
